Background work: the run command (the one run without arguments, unless the app has http, which takes it) runs the app's processes side by side until the app is asked to stop, then lets each finish. A process is a function that runs until its context ends; worker.Every runs one at an interval. Your processes go in cmd/&lt;app>/processes.go, which starts with an example; other blueprints add theirs to the worker.processes slot.

```esquadro
blueprint worker
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [http](../http/) when the app uses them.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `worker.imports` | Imports of cmd/&lt;app>/worker.go. |
| `worker.processes` | Processes other blueprints run, as worker.Process values followed by a comma, e.g. {Name: "queue", Run: d.queue.Run},; d is the dependencies. |
